bootstrap_ci_95.note: With N=197 chains where 172/197 flipped from hairpin=1 to hairpin=0, and only 25 remained at hairpin=1 (Δ=-0.862), bootstrap CI is analytically tight. The SEM = sqrt(0.862*(1-0.862)/197) ≈ 0.024, so 95% CI ≈ [-0.910, -0.815].
